feature: Every locally generated CN number now carries the warehouse prefix from WAREHOUSE_CODE (default HK): nextCnBrandedNo mints [WH]-[brand]-yyyymmdd-seq (covers the local Excel upload's order batch_no, manual-receipt invoice_no = order batch_no, and pdf-upload workflow batch_no) and nextCnTruckNo mints [WH]-[truckRef]-YYYYMMDD(-seq) for truck manifests — e.g. SZ-TE-20261119-01, HK-KOA-20261119-01. One backend instance runs per warehouse with its own DB, so before this two warehouses could mint identical numbers on the same day; HQ-side reports and the DocPal workflow trail aggregate across warehouses. Legacy unprefixed rows keep their shape (no migration; each warehouse's prefixed sequence starts fresh). The random CN-yyyymmdd-XXXXXX DocPal correlation key is unchanged. Advisory-lock keys, the MAX-scan split_part and the match regex all moved to the prefixed shape; the brand is sanitized inside the numbering function.
reason: CN numbers are generated locally per warehouse instance but are read fleet-wide, so unprefixed per-day sequences collided across warehouses (e.g. both HK and SZ minting TE-20261119-01)
remarks: Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-19-cn-numbering-warehouse-prefix-design.md. Operator decision 2026-11-19: HK also carries the prefix (uniform rule); prefix applies to ALL CN number families, not just TE. Verified: receivingCn.test.ts 9/9 (format assertions, advisory-lock race, new WAREHOUSE_CODE=sz prefix + legacy-restart test); tsc clean. Deploy note: WAREHOUSE_CODE is already set on SZ/SH/BJ instances; HK needs no env change (falls back to HK).
